{{Quote|One of my colleagues was arrested on Garos. He's being forced to work at the research facility. I just want to get him out.|[[Alexandra Winger]]|<ref name="Rendezvous with Destiny">{{JournalCite|6|Rendezvous with Destiny}}</ref>}}
The '''Mission to Sarahwiee''' was carried out by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sometimes after the end of the [[Thrawn campaign]].

==Background==
Soon after the death of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]],<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] learned that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was researching new weapons technology on [[Sarahwiee]], and assigned the [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]] to infiltrating the Imperial base. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] joined them on the mission. The [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] first went to [[Garos IV]] to rendezvous with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tere Metallo]] of the ''[[Star Quest]]'', a free-[[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who was offering his own [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] as a backup escape craft for the mission. Both [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were loaded with supplies before rendezvousing with an Imperial informant who provided them with [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates for Sarahwiee; they traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] under the guise of trading.

==The mission==
{{Quote|I've seen you in my visions of this place.|Alex Winger, to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Rendezvous with Destiny" />}}
[[File:Luke_and_Alex.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Alexandra Winger|Alex Winger]] share a kiss to lure an Imperial.]]

The commandos were tasked with destroying the base's research labs, factories, and warehouse facilities, as well as uploading several viruses into the main [[Computer/Legends|computer]] network. They split into three teams, while a fourth team led by Luke Skywalker.

During the mission the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] met with Garosian resistance fighter [[Alexandra Winger]] who had infiltrated the base in the ''Star Quest'' to rescue a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] held at the facility. The blue-eyed man of her dreams agreed to help her and they were able to rescue [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Carl Barzon]]. However, Luke and Alex were discovered in the hangar by the Imperial forces and managed to eliminate all enemies with the help of the crew of the ''Star Quest'', Captain Metallo and [[Gil Crosear]].

[[File:Alex_falls.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke Skywalker rescues Alexandra Winger.]]

All four teams met with success, escaping the planet before the detonations caused by the charges they had laid occurred.

==Aftermath==
Alex Winger's actions brought Garos IV's situation to the attention of the New Republic, leading to the [[Battle of Garos|liberation]] of the planet.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />
